notes: Dogfood seed for the Realtime Client SDK roadmap.
Each node is created with kernel type 'entity'; the ontology type lives in data.type.
All IDs use the 'entity:' prefix to match the active TQL namespace.

data.title: Realtime Client SDK
data.description: SSE-first self-hosted realtime client. Replaces the InstantDB cloud path with a Trellis-native transport that serves three consumers: external apps, internal apps/web, and cross-agent federation.

data.title: One transport, three lenses
data.description: apps/web cloud mode runs on Trellis without InstantDB; external apps and federation use the same wire protocol. SSE+HTTP is the only realtime path.

data.title: M0 — Decisions Locked
data.description: Six open questions resolved, schema spec drafted, wire protocol envelope sketched. Gate: no code lands until this closes.

data.title: M1 — Realtime Core (transport)
data.description: @trellis/realtime-core ships. SSE client with resume + reconnect, mutation pipe with idempotency, session-token auth. Wire-only, no cache.

data.title: M2 — Reactive Client
data.description: @trellis/client + @trellis/client-vue ship. Cache, op-application, optimistic mutations, outbox. apps/web local mode flips to new adapter.

data.title: M3 — Auth Migration
data.description: Magic-code auth, JWT + refresh tokens, session revocation. apps/web flips off InstantDB auth. Unlocks platform data migration.

data.title: M4 — Platform Data Migration
data.description: Orgs, members, settings, notifications port from InstantDB to TQL ontologies. cloud-adapter rewritten on realtime-core. @instantdb/* removed.

data.title: M5 — Federation Overlay
data.description: @trellis/federation ships. Per-agent op streams, subscription filters, decision-trace hydration. Unblocks PLATFORM.md Phase 1 (Dev Agent home Facility).

data.title: M6 — Dogfood Cutover
data.description: apps/web cloud mode runs on Trellis-native realtime end-to-end. Magic-code login, multi-tab sync, perf parity, federation Phase 1 demo green.

data.title: Query shape — InstantDB proxy syntax vs EQL-S
data.description: Should the reactive client expose `db.query({ ns: { $: { where } } })` for zero-friction migration, or unify on EQL-S to stay consistent with TQL elsewhere?
data.rationale: Proxy syntax: trivial migration for apps/web, familiar to current contributors, but two query languages in the codebase. EQL-S: one language end to end, but every existing call site rewrites.

data.title: Cache strategy — handroll vs TanStack Query
data.description: Build a query-keyed cache that natively applies ops (like InstantDB), or adopt TanStack Query and bolt op-application on top?
data.rationale: Handroll: full control over op-application, op log is the source of truth for cache invalidation, but more code to own. TanStack: huge ecosystem, but doesn't natively understand op streams; we'd be fighting its invalidation model.

data.title: Schema language — port instant.schema.ts to trellis.schema.ts
data.description: Port the existing InstantDB schema spec into a Trellis-native `trellis.schema.ts` that drives server validation, client cache shape, and TS types from one source?
data.rationale: Single schema avoids drift between server ontologies and client types. Lean: yes, port it. Open question is whether it codegens TQL ontology entries or stays a parallel surface.

data.title: Presence/awareness — Phase 0 or deferred
data.description: Ship presence (cursors, typing, focus) in M1, or defer? SSE is one-way, so presence forces either a WS sidecar or HTTP heartbeats with a presence sub-channel.
data.rationale: Phase 0: forces dual-transport from day one but unblocks collab features. Deferred: SSE-only stays clean for v1, presence joins as a transport overlay later. Lean: deferred unless a concrete collab feature needs it pre-M6.

data.title: Federation auth — Wallet/Ed25519 v1 vs session-only v1
data.description: Sign cross-agent ops with a Wallet (Ed25519 pubkey) from day one (matches PLATFORM.md), or use session tokens for M5 and add Wallet later?
data.rationale: Wallet from day one: federation provenance is structural, no migration. Session-only: ships M5 faster but accumulates technical debt that touches every cross-agent surface.

data.title: Multi-tab — SharedWorker vs per-tab connections
data.description: Single SSE per origin via a SharedWorker, or per-tab connections with server-side fan-out?
data.rationale: SharedWorker: one connection per user, clean. Per-tab: simpler to ship, but N connections per user and bigger fan-out cost on the server. Lean: per-tab for v1, SharedWorker as an opt-in optimization.

data.title: Draft wire protocol spec
data.description: Define the SSE event envelope, mutation envelope, error shapes, and idempotency-key semantics. Output: doc + JSON schemas.

data.title: Draft trellis.schema.ts spec
data.description: Output of decision-schema-language: spec for the unified schema language driving server validation + client cache + TS types.

data.title: Extract TrellisClient.watch() into realtime-core SSE client
data.description: New package @trellis/realtime-core. Pull the SSE parsing loop out of trellis-cli/src/client.ts and own it as the canonical browser+Node client.

data.title: Last-Event-ID resume + reconnect-with-backoff
data.description: Client resumes the op stream from the last delivered op id. Exponential backoff on disconnect, jitter, max-retry policy.

data.title: /api/graph/events accepts filter params
data.description: Server-side: events.get.ts honors ?since=&zone=&type= and Last-Event-ID header. Replay the op log delta on resume.

data.title: Session-token auth on SSE handshake + mutations
data.description: Auth header on SSE connect; rejected handshakes return a typed reason. Session-token refresh resumes the stream cleanly.

data.title: Mutation pipe with idempotency-key
data.description: POST /api/graph/mutate accepts an idempotency-key header; server dedups within a sliding window. Client retries safely.

data.title: Migrate trellis-cli + hooks to realtime-core
data.description: trellis-cli/src/client.ts + hooks/* delegate to @trellis/realtime-core. Existing TrellisClient API stays intact.

data.title: Transport integration tests
data.description: Test matrix: dropped connection mid-stream, late-arriving ops, filter correctness, idempotency dedup, token refresh during stream.

data.title: Query-keyed cache with op-application
data.description: Cache holds materialized query results. Inbound ops are applied to cached entries (no refetch). Cache invalidation == op-log replay.

data.title: db.tx proxy compatible with current adapter shape
data.description: Match the existing DataAdapter tx proxy API (db.tx.ns[id].action(data)). Migration to apps/web should be import-swap, not rewrite.

data.title: Optimistic mutations + server-rollback
data.description: Mutations apply locally before server confirm; on reject, rollback ops are emitted to revert the cache. Decision traces preserve attempted+rejected.

data.title: Mutation outbox for offline periods
data.description: Persist queued mutations across disconnects/page-reloads; flush on reconnect with idempotency-key replay.

data.title: subscribeQuery matching DataAdapter interface
data.description: Same callback shape and unsubscribe semantics as the current data-adapter. Drop-in replacement.

data.title: @trellis/client-vue composables
data.description: useQuery, useTx, useAgentStream. Reactive Vue 3 wrappers over the client core. React adapter deferred.

data.title: New local-adapter built on realtime-core
data.description: Replaces the ad-hoc fetch+EventSource path in apps/web/app/lib/data-adapter/local-adapter.ts. Same interface, new transport.

data.title: apps/web local mode regression test pass
data.description: Full e2e + vitest run against local mode using the new adapter. Zero-regression bar before merging.

data.title: POST /api/auth/magic-code
data.description: Email magic-code generation + send. Rate-limited. Replaces InstantDB sendMagicCode.

data.title: POST /api/auth/verify → JWT + refresh token
data.description: Verify code, issue access JWT (short TTL) + refresh token (long TTL, rotating).

data.title: Session entity + revocation API
data.description: TQL ontology for session. Revocation flips the entity's status; SSE handshakes consult it. Logout = revoke.

data.title: Refresh-token rotation + cookie strategy
data.description: Refresh tokens rotate on use; HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax cookies; cross-origin SDK uses Authorization header.

data.title: apps/web auth plugin switches to /api/auth/*
data.description: Replace InstantDB auth calls in plugins/instant.client.ts. subscribeAuth wires to the new session feed.

data.title: Rewrite resolve-invites.post.ts against TQL
data.description: Port apps/web/server/api/resolve-invites.post.ts off InstantDB to use TQL members/notifications ontologies.

data.title: TQL ontologies: org, member, setting, notification
data.description: Mirror apps/web/instant.schema.ts as TQL ontologies. Field-level parity verified by a snapshot test.

data.title: Migration script: instantdb → tql
data.description: One-shot script that reads from InstantDB and writes TQL entities + links. Idempotent. Used per-tenant during cutover.

data.title: cloud-adapter rewritten on realtime-core
data.description: apps/web/app/lib/data-adapter/cloud-adapter.ts is reimplemented against @trellis/realtime-core. No InstantDB calls remain.

data.title: Feature-parity test matrix
data.description: Every DataAdapter method (subscribeQuery, queryOnce, transact, tx proxy, auth) verified in cloud mode against the TQL backend.

data.title: Remove @instantdb/* from package.json
data.description: Drop @instantdb/admin, @instantdb/core, @instantdb/vue. Verify no runtime imports remain.

data.title: Decommission plugins/instant.client.ts
data.description: Delete the Instant client plugin and any composables that referenced it directly. Adapter pattern stays intact.

data.title: /api/agents/{id}/ops stream endpoint
data.description: Per-agent SSE stream + history-since variant. Filtered by zone visibility of the requesting agent.

data.title: Subscription filter spec
data.description: Formalize zone, nodeType, since filters. Filter is part of the subscription contract; server enforces zone authority.

data.title: @trellis/federation client
data.description: createFederation API: subscribe(agentId, filter, cb), publish(agentId, op). Layered on realtime-core; no special transport.

data.title: Decision-trace hydration on op arrival
data.description: When a Decision op arrives via federation, hydrate the Decision → Artifact → Agent → Zone path into the local cache.

data.title: End-to-end demo: founder Lab ⇔ Dev Workshop
data.description: Founder assigns a task to agent:dev; decision trace from the dev agent appears in founder Lab via op stream. Phase 1 of PLATFORM.md.

data.title: Acceptance: magic-code login end-to-end
data.description: Full login flow against Trellis-native auth on staging.

data.title: Acceptance: multi-tab realtime sync
data.description: Two tabs open against staging stay in sync via SSE; matches current InstantDB UX.

data.title: Acceptance: Lighthouse + perf parity
data.description: Cloud mode on Trellis-native realtime hits the same perf bar as the InstantDB baseline.

data.title: Acceptance: federation Phase 1 demo green
data.description: PLATFORM.md Phase 1 demo runs end-to-end against the new SDK; decision traces appear in founder Lab.
